mechanism_summary: The container's cache-warmup step builds an in-memory catalog cache of roughly 200MiB, which exceeds its 64Mi memory limit; the kernel OOM-killer terminates the container (OOMKilled, exit code 137) before serving ever begins.
decisive_evidence: containerStatuses for the recs/recommendations pod show lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled with exit code 137 and a climbing restartCount; the container spec carries resources.limits.memory 64Mi, and logs show 'warming catalog cache' but never 'catalog cache ready'.
remediation_summary: Raise the memory limit on the recommendations deployment's container so the ~200MiB warmup cache fits with headroom: kubectl -n recs set resources deployment/recommendations --limits=memory=1Gi --requests=memory=256Mi, then wait for the rollout to complete; warmup finishes and the serve loop keeps the pod Ready.
